title: pvHyperTreeGrid
body:
## pvHyperTreeGrid

Builds a hyper tree grid (vtkHyperTreeGrid), a tree-based AMR structure: a rectilinear grid of root cells, each refined recursively by a binary (BranchFactor 2) or ternary (3) subdivision described by the Descriptor string. In the descriptor, levels are separated by "|", "R" marks a refined cell and "." a leaf, e.g. "RR | .R. ... | ...". Use it to construct exact test cases for hyper-tree-grid filters; for random trees use pvHyperTreeGridRandom.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The descriptor must be consistent with Dimensions, BranchFactor and MaxDepth (one character per cell on each level); an inconsistent string produces an error or an empty grid.
- Many standard filters do not accept hyper tree grids directly; convert to an unstructured grid first when needed.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGrid`. Identity: `sources/HyperTreeGridSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BranchFactor` | This property specifies the subdivision scheme (binary or ternary) of the hyper tree grid. | `{"maximum":3,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |
| `Descriptor` | This property specifies the string used to describe the hyper tree grid. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Dimensions` | The three values in this property specify the number of points in each dimension of the hyper tree grid. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GridScale` | The three values in this property specify the scale of the root cells in each dimension of the hyper tree grid. | `{"items":{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` |
| `MaxDepth` | The value of this property specifies the maximum number of levels in the hyper tree grid. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

```json
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvHyperTreeGrid"
}
```
